title: 500WS Eat Lunch
bodyHtml:
500WS Eat Lunch with Dr. Emma Hodcroft

We are happy to announce that Emma Hodcroft, who is an epidemiologist from Basel and co-developer of nextstrain, an open-source project to track pathogen evolution in real-time.

Dr. Hodcroft is one of the KEY Swiss players in research and communication about COVID-19. She discussed with us how she has communicated her highly topical research practically hot off the press and what challenges she currently faces with science communication of a topic of such wide-spread interest.

www.emmahodcroft.com

¨500WS eat lunch" is a series of networking events in which our members have the opportunity to meet women leaders in academia, industry, funding bodies and research institutions and discuss career strategies with them and get valuable advice and insights.
